datasets.description: The World Heritage List includes 1223 properties forming part of the cultural and natural heritage which the World Heritage Committee considers as having outstanding universal value.

publisher.name: United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO)

datasets.purpose: To identify and document cultural and natural heritage sites of outstanding universal value for conservation, management, and protection under the UNESCO World Heritage Convention.
datasets.details: The World Heritage List comprises 1,223 properties representing cultural and natural heritage sites designated by the World Heritage Committee as having outstanding universal value. These sites include cultural landmarks, natural areas, and mixed properties that are recognized for their exceptional significance to humanity and require international cooperation for their preservation. The list supports heritage conservation efforts, promotes awareness of cultural and natural diversity, and guides policy decisions for site protection and management worldwide.

contact_point.name: United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO)

sources.name: World Heritage Sites
sources.description: UNESCO World Heritage List - the global inventory of cultural and natural sites of outstanding universal value, designated by the UNESCO World Heritage Committee under the 1972 World Heritage Convention. Maintained by the UNESCO World Heritage Centre. Covers approximately 1,200 properties across 168 states parties, with attributes including site name, category (cultural, natural, or mixed), country, coordinates, and year of inscription.
